name: Sweeping Broom

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Sweeps a 20-ft square by itself until told to stop.
text: As a Magic action you can set this broom sweeping a 20-foot square centered on a point on the ground you can see within 60 feet. It keeps going until you stop it with another Magic action.

params.text: whisks away the dust and debris of a 20-ft square
